engineering works, timetable changes, strikes, weather), with the alerts
about the same event merged. Most severe first, then newest. Per-train
notices such as delay reasons are left out.

get.description:
Railway stations, lines (S10, Z30, ...) or trains ranked by on-time share
(at most 5 minutes late), then by median delay. Stations count every stop
passage; lines and trains count one arrival per run, at its final stop (or
the last stop recorded before it). HÉV and tram-train stops, and the runs
ending at them, are left out.

LiveActivityPushTokenCreate.title: LiveActivityPushTokenCreate
LiveActivityPushTokenCreate.description:
The ActivityKit push token of one followed trip's iOS Live Activity. It
receives `update` events while the train runs and `end` once it has passed
the alighting station; alerts about that follow are shown on it instead of
as a separate notification.

LiveActivitySetup.title: LiveActivitySetup

iOS: the follow's Live Activity, started by the API with a push some
minutes before departure (iOS 17.2+). What the activity shows until the
train is live, as the app saw the train when following it.

LiveActivityStartTokenCreate.title: LiveActivityStartTokenCreate
LiveActivityStartTokenCreate.description:
The device's ActivityKit push-to-start token (iOS 17.2+). The API starts
the Live Activity of a follow with `liveActivity` set with it shortly
before departure; the started activity's own token is then registered as
`liveactivity`. A device has one: registering another replaces it.
